Meaningful Holiday#001.src: Hello, dear. My name is Haily. Nice to meet you.
Meaningful Holiday#001.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#002.src: This is the {p} Charity center. We're looking for volunteers to help the homeless this year.
Meaningful Holiday#002.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#003.src: If you want to help someone else this year, our boss Nick is already in the thick of it.
Meaningful Holiday#003.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#004.src: He's a really special man. I'll write his location down for you in your book. Oh, remember this is charity work, so hopefully gratitude is a good enough reward for you.
Meaningful Holiday#004.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#005.src: Go talk to Haily's friend Nick at the poor area.

Meaningful Holiday#006.src: Oh. Oh... Oh dear. There's more people here than ever.
Meaningful Holiday#006.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#007.src: Hm, are you just passing through? Oh! A volunteer!
Meaningful Holiday#007.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#008.src: You're the only one this year. Things have really changed. We used to have hundreds of volunteers this time of year.
Meaningful Holiday#008.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#009.src: The people here are starving. There's no two ways about it.
Meaningful Holiday#009.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#010.src: I don't know how we're going to feed everyone this year.
Meaningful Holiday#010.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#011.src: The man who runs the budget store used to be homeless... He knows the struggles they face.
Meaningful Holiday#011.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#012.src: I'll look after things here. Can you go to the budget store? It's really close. Any food is gratefully received.
Meaningful Holiday#012.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#013.src: Go to the budget store and ask for food.

Meaningful Holiday#015.src: What can I do fer ye?
Meaningful Holiday#015.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#017.src: I'm sorry but everyfin is sold out, everyone is preparing for Craftmas lad.
Meaningful Holiday#017.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#018.src: I might have something in the attic, if you find anyfin, you can 'ave it. I know how difficult it gets.
Meaningful Holiday#018.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#019.src: Look for food on the second floor.

Meaningful Holiday#020.src: Hm... This apple has seen betta days.
Meaningful Holiday#020.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#021.src: Looks like i'm fresh outta food. Barely got enough to feed myself.
Meaningful Holiday#021.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#022.src: I wish I had something to give this year. I guess people are having a feast in the city.
Meaningful Holiday#022.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#023.src: Return to Nick and tell him the bad news.

Meaningful Holiday#025.src: I see. I was counting on him.
Meaningful Holiday#025.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#026.src: I can't be too upset. He donates so much the rest of the year.
Meaningful Holiday#026.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#027.src: We may have to ask the farmers directly...
Meaningful Holiday#027.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#028.src: I know someone in {p} with a kind heart.
Meaningful Holiday#028.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#029.src: We've fallen out before, seems he didn't understand what a donation was.
Meaningful Holiday#029.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#030.src: There is a shortcut south from here, in a cave. Go through there.
Meaningful Holiday#030.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#031.src: Oh, also, could you give this blanket to Margaret while you're down in the tunnel? Just follow the road behind me.
Meaningful Holiday#031.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#032.src: Bring the blanket to the woman in the tunnel south of Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#033.src: Oh, please don't move me along. I have nowhere else to go!
Meaningful Holiday#033.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#034.src: Oh, a blanket for me? How sweet... From Nick, you say? He's always so kind... Thank you, as well.
Meaningful Holiday#034.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#035.src: If you want to get to {p} quickly, just keep going through this tunnel. Some unfriendly homeless folks live around here too, so be careful. It's so sad, their state.
Meaningful Holiday#035.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#036.src: Continue the tunnel and find Nick's friend.

Meaningful Holiday#037.src: Welcome to my farm! Looking to buy some of my fresh crops?
Meaningful Holiday#037.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#038.src: Well, it seems you're out of luck. I've just sold the last of them from this harvest.
Meaningful Holiday#038.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#039.src: It was all for that big Craftmas feast happening in {p}. Wish I could help you out, but I'm fresh out of food to sell you.
Meaningful Holiday#039.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#040.src: Wait, I bet Nick sent you, didn't he? Well, he's coming up on your left. Remind him that this isn't a charity.
Meaningful Holiday#040.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#042.src: We can't get any food? We're running out of options here...
Meaningful Holiday#042.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#043.src: Well, there's only one person left that we can appeal to at this time of year.
Meaningful Holiday#043.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#045.src: Explore the area and look for Santa.

Meaningful Holiday#046.src: Heya! I just finished decorating this christmas tree!
Meaningful Holiday#046.speaker: Elvura

Meaningful Holiday#048.src: He is right down the stairs to the right.
Meaningful Holiday#048.speaker: Elvura

Meaningful Holiday#049.src: Enter Santa's home and speak to him.

Meaningful Holiday#051.src: The council all have their areas to care for. Yours is {p}. How you care for it is your responsibility.
Meaningful Holiday#051.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#052.src: There's five times more homeless and hungry than last year!
Meaningful Holiday#052.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#053.src: Nick, I know times are tough there, but-
Meaningful Holiday#053.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#054.src: Tough?! It's impossible! What happened to people's good will? I had one volunteer this year! ONE!
Meaningful Holiday#054.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#055.src: I'm sorry Nick. You could go to {p} and ask there, they have a feast big enough to feed an army!
Meaningful Holiday#055.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#056.src: Hmmm... Oh, sorry. I miscalculated your journey here. Good to see you.
Meaningful Holiday#056.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#057.src: I suppose you heard Santa and I. Our next location is {p}.
Meaningful Holiday#057.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#058.src: Alright, that's settled then. Leave through the fireplace behind me, it will bring you directly to {p}. Good luck, Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#058.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#059.src: Leave through the portal behind Santa.

Meaningful Holiday#061.src: Wow. The people here live in such grandure. I wonder if they know people are starving to the east.
Meaningful Holiday#061.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#062.src: Let's ask around for some donations.
Meaningful Holiday#062.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#063.src: More importantly, let's hope they'll share a trifle of food.
Meaningful Holiday#063.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#067.src: You aren't even in a formal dress.
Meaningful Holiday#067.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#069.src: Food? You want food? Does this look like a charity to you?
Meaningful Holiday#069.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#070.src: Of course not! We have an obligation to feed our partygoers, not some poor scraps of men in the desert!
Meaningful Holiday#070.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#071.src: Now get out of here before I call the security golems. And don't even think of stealing from the kitchen!
Meaningful Holiday#071.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#072.src: Steal the food from the kitchen and talk to Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#073.src: Were you able to get any food?
Meaningful Holiday#073.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#074.src: You do?! I didn't expect them to be so generous, a whole crate?
Meaningful Holiday#074.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#077.src: Stealing is not in the christmas spirit... But I think I can make this work.
Meaningful Holiday#077.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#078.src: Go on ahead. I have a plan. Don't worry, I'll return all this food.
Meaningful Holiday#078.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#081.src: I know you are hungry. Because I am too.
Meaningful Holiday#081.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#082.src: But your dinner will not be served tonight.
Meaningful Holiday#082.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#083.src: There will be no Craftmas feast this year!
Meaningful Holiday#083.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#085.src: The food on the table isn't enough to feed everyone here!
Meaningful Holiday#085.speaker: Guest

Meaningful Holiday#086.src: This one night, this one missed meal.
Meaningful Holiday#086.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#087.src: This is how thousands of people live every day.
Meaningful Holiday#087.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#088.src: Hungry, wondering when the food will be available.
Meaningful Holiday#088.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#089.src: And while you sit there with empty stomachs be thankful for what you have. Spare a thought for those who have not.
Meaningful Holiday#089.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#090.src: Hundreds of men, women and children, just like you, will not eat tonight, at all.
Meaningful Holiday#090.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#091.src: All because this enormous feast was not enough. {p} bought all the food, cheap or expensive.
Meaningful Holiday#091.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#092.src: I'm here to remind you the real meaning of this day. To think of others..
Meaningful Holiday#092.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#093.src: I will return your meal tonight, but while you eat it... I want you to remember every empty mouth it could have fed.
Meaningful Holiday#093.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#094.src: Share what you have, be thankful for what you are given.
Meaningful Holiday#094.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#096.src: Well, looks like you came through yet again Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#097.src: I came to see if I could help out. But it looks like you've done it.
Meaningful Holiday#097.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#098.src: Well, I guess there is only one thing left to do to complete this scene.
Meaningful Holiday#098.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#099.src: Hope you all have a merry craftmas. Ho-ho!
Meaningful Holiday#099.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#101.src: It looks like my little speech brought the rich back down to earth.
Meaningful Holiday#101.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#102.src: They gave us half of their feast. Can you believe they still had leftovers?
Meaningful Holiday#102.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#103.src: All of that food, going straight to waste.
Meaningful Holiday#103.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#104.src: They have no idea what they have, compared to these poor folks.
Meaningful Holiday#104.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#105.src: You might be wondering why I know Santa. Well, he's my brother.
Meaningful Holiday#105.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#106.src: Me and my siblings take care of people at Craftmas. My area is the {p} desert. I guess you could call me Sanda Claus, heh.
Meaningful Holiday#106.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#107.src: It's people like you that keep the real meaning of this holiday alive. It gets harder every year as the meaning is distorted. Here is a personal gift from me. Thank you.
Meaningful Holiday#107.speaker: Nick
